info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Settlement Reviews API
info.description: The Financial Settlement Reviews API facilitates the submission of reviews related to financial settlements processed via card payments. This endpoint enables businesses to collect feedback on their settlement processes, allowing stakeholders to assess and enhance the quality of financial operations. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and payment processors seeking to improve their services based on user responses. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure transparency and efficiency in their financial settlements.

post.summary: Create a review for a card financial settlement.
post.description: This operation allows you to submit a review for a specific card financial settlement identified by CARD-400045. It is intended for users who want to provide feedback on their transaction experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a review for the financial settlement related to the card identified by CARD-400045. The review typically includes details such as user feedback, ratings, and any comments pertinent to the transaction. Ensure that the submitted data adheres to the defined schema for proper processing.
